TechnoMag reports Palp Technologies, at Bindura University's industrial park, assembles smartphones (from US$80), laptops and tablets locally.
Avantis Technology operates a factory in Msasa, Harare, that manufactures and assembles laptops and notebooks; its CEO says about 25,000 of a 60,000 target for 2026 were built by 14 May 2026.

The Herald reports President Mnangagwa commissioned the PALPO Technologies Production Plant at Bindura University, which assembles laptops, tablets and cellphones, with a full capacity of 12,000 laptops and tablets and 3,000 phones.
